_source.title: 获取当前板子的详细属性
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前打开且拥有最后输入焦点的原理图、PCB 所关联的板子的详细属性
_source.returns: 板子的详细属性，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get detailed properties of Current board
remarks.text.0: It will get the detailed properties of the board associated with the currently open schematic or PCB that has the last input focus
returns: Board detailed properties of; if it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
